summary.connection_policy: one new curl process per request; 1 second pause

analytics_query: SELECT blob4 AS country, blob16 AS ingress_colo, blob17 AS asn, blob8 AS endpoint, blob19 AS traffic_type, SUM(_sample_interval) AS requests FROM "makanmasak-metrics-prod" WHERE blob1 = 'api_request' AND blob19 = 'probe' AND timestamp >= toDateTime(1790041546) AND timestamp <= toDateTime(1790041741) AND blob8 IN ('/info', '/api/v1/orders', '/api/v1/analytics/realtime-dashboard') GROUP BY country, ingress_colo, asn, endpoint, traffic_type ORDER BY endpoint;
